data.one_liner: Flutter SDK for Microsoft Clarity session replay, heatmaps and interaction analytics.
data.what_it_does: Captures user screens, taps and gestures in mobile apps and uploads the data to Microsoft Clarity. Provides session recordings, heatmaps and basic interaction insights without additional backend setup.
use_when: You need privacy‑focused session replay and heatmaps for a Flutter mobile app
You want automatic web‑view capture and masking
You prefer a lightweight analytics SDK that requires only a few lines of code
avoid_when: You need offline data collection or custom event pipelines
You require advanced analytics features like funnels, smart events or deep custom reporting
Your app targets platforms other than Android or iOS
strengths: Session recordings and heatmaps out of the box
Automatic web‑view capture and widget masking
weaknesses: Limited to Android and iOS only
No support for smart events, funnels or advanced analytics
